guide.text: Stop, look at the R position on the shifter and press O. The rear camera turns on automatically. Press N to look at its screen with the keyboard. The guidelines bend with the steering, and the distance bands, sensor bars and text show nearby obstacles. Reverse at walking speed. A walk-around is optional unless your trainer requires it in a tight space.

required.text: The trainer requires a walk-around in this tight space. Park and get out. Stand behind the van, face the reversing path and press G to record the check. Then use the camera and mirrors to reverse into the bay.

resumeMenu.text: Practice uses a separate checkpoint. Your workday and cargo lesson stay saved.
